title: A private AI back end for one Mac

scenes.heading: A private AI back end for one Mac
bullets: Started on demand, unloaded when idle
scenes.narration: This is a private AI back end for a single Mac. It runs open weight models on Apple silicon, starts them when they are needed, and unloads them when they go quiet. Nothing ever leaves the machine.

scenes.heading: Memory is the real constraint
bullets: Together they do not fit in 48 GB
So the gateway keeps a memory budget
scenes.narration: The binding constraint is memory, not speed. A thirty billion parameter coding model takes about seventeen gigabytes, and a general model takes twenty one. They do not fit together, so the gateway keeps a memory budget, and evicts the model that has been idle the longest.

scenes.heading: One gateway, many backends
scenes.narration: Claude Code and the browser talk to one gateway. Behind it sit the chat models, the decision and entailment models, and now speech in both directions. The gateway starts each one on first use, and stops it when it has been idle.

scenes.heading: Decide, don't generate
bullets: Score a closed list of options
One forward pass, about one second
scenes.narration: The most useful trick is to decide instead of generate. A decision model scores every option in a single forward pass, and returns probabilities. It is fast, deterministic, and cheap, so most pipelines here are plain code that calls a scorer.

scenes.heading: And now it can talk
bullets: Qwen3-TTS: design or clone a voice
scenes.narration: Phase nine adds speech. Kokoro gives fast, clean narration. Qwen three T T S can design a voice from a description, or clone one from a short clip. Whisper listens to the result, and returns word timestamps for the captions. This very video was narrated, captioned and assembled on this Mac.
